bill.title: A resolution expressing the sense of the Senate that the Russian Federation started the war against Ukraine by launching an unprovoked full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations. (text: CR S1584)
bill.officialSummary: This resolution expresses the sense that Russia initiated the war against Ukraine by invading Ukraine on February 24, 2022.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
